title: NIST WebBook: Ammonium sulfate is H8N2O4S, molecular weight 132.140 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Ammonium sulfate as H8N2O4S, molecular weight 132.140 amu, CAS 7783-20-2.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Ammonium sulfate, CAS Registry Number 7783-20-2, lists molecular formula H8N2O4S and molecular weight 132.140 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 132.02047774 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/H8N2O4S/c1-5-7(3,4)6-2/h1-2H4. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
